name: Diun

retired.note: No longer offered: its notifications overlap with What's Up Docker. Existing Diun containers keep running and are still recognized; nothing is removed.

description: Docker Image Update Notifier: headless, notification-only image update checks (ntfy, mail, Discord, ...).
installNote: Diun has no web interface, so it is listed for reference; What's Up Docker covers the same need with a UI and an official read-only proxy recipe. Diun's socket-proxy permissions (CONTAINERS=1, IMAGES=1) were derived from its source, not its docs.
